description.value: The BC Aviation Museum is the permanent home of the Hawaii Martin Mars, one of the world's largest flying boats, and houses a wide collection of historic BC aviation artifacts, archives, and memorials. Located on Norseman Road at the Victoria International Airport in North Saanich, it draws aviation enthusiasts from across the region. Touring cyclists will find it a striking destination on the Saanich Peninsula, with Flight Deck Tours offered weekly.

address.value: 1910 Norseman Road, North Saanich, B.C. V8L 5V5

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, publicly accessible aviation museum open daily in the Saanich Peninsula — a clear fit for the WWC Attractions directory as a destination for touring cyclists on the Peninsula.

wow_evidence: Permanent home of the Hawaii Martin Mars — the world's largest flying boat — plus 40 aircraft; walking under the Mars is the story at dinner. Cluster parent for the hangar nodes.
blurb: Aviation museum at Victoria Airport, home of the giant Hawaii Martin Mars flying boat.
